title: On Employing four men through the winter
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：employ　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 employ 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the grandmother ① employed four men through the winter before dawn, and every child in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grandmother ② employs four men through the winter in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ employ four men through the winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ employed four men through the winter before — a line in the diary for February 1950 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Employing four men through the winter before dawn, the grandmother said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ employ the old method once more in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Employ the old method once more at once and never mention it again.

By 1963 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the diary, and a new child from the next courtyard ⑧ employs the old method once more before dawn every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the window, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ employed four men through the winter again when nobody else would.

⑩ To employ four men through the winter, my mother said in 1968, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the courtyard remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the courtyard forgets, somebody employs four men through the winter in public again and somebody must employ four men through the winter before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 雇用（一般过去式 employed four men through the winter：1956 年祖母头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 雇用（一般现在 employs four men through the winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 雇用（不定式 to employ four men through the winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 雇用（过去完成时 had employed four men through the winter：1950 年二月的日记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 雇用（动名词 employing four men through the winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使用（employ the old method once more：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使用再一次用那套老办法）
G. v. 使用（employ the old method once more：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 雇用（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 employs the old method once more，而母亲又一次 employed four men through the winter）

answers.why: employ 意为“雇用”，1956 年祖母天没亮就雇用整个冬天雇着四个人，那是院子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 employed。
employ 意为“雇用”，自那以后祖母当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 employs。
employ 意为“雇用”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯雇用整个冬天雇着四个人”，此处为不定式 to employ four men through the winter。
employ 意为“雇用”，日记里 二月 那行字说明早在 1963 年之前就有人雇用过，故用过去完成时 had employed。
employ 意为“雇用”，祖母说“雇用整个冬天雇着四个人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 employing four men through the winter 作主语。
employ 意为“使用”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使用再一次用那套老办法”，should ever 之后用原形 employ the old method once more。
employ 意为“使用”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使用再一次用那套老办法（employ the old method once more at once），以后再也不要提起。
employ 意为“雇用”，新来的孩子每个年头都照例使用再一次用那套老办法，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 employs。
employ 意为“雇用”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就雇用整个冬天雇着四个人，用一般过去式 employed 叙述。
employ 意为“雇用”，结尾那句是母亲 1968 年的话：要雇用整个冬天雇着四个人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和院子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 employ 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the grandmother employed four men through the winter before dawn, and nobody in the courtyard forgot it.
Even now the grandmother employs four men through the winter in public whenever the courtyard asks.
Employing four men through the winter before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever employ the old method once more in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next courtyard employs the old method once more before dawn every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother employed four men through the winter again, and the courtyard remembered that half.
